comparisons.peer_topic: Wealth segment business definition and scope
comparisons.peer_summary: The Wealth segment comprises the Private Bank, Wealth at Work, and Citigold businesses, providing financial services such as banking, lending, and custody to affluent, high net worth, and ultra-high net worth clients across 20 countries including the U.S., Mexico, Singapore, Hong Kong, the UAE, and London.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPM and C disclose the composition of their international consumer or wealth-related initiatives and geographic scope. JPM's 'Other Corporate' segment aggregates specific international consumer initiatives (Chase U.K., Nutmeg, C6 Bank) that are reported separately from core domestic retail banking. Similarly, C defines its 'Wealth' segment scope, which includes specific international centers (Singapore, Hong Kong, UAE, London) and businesses (Private Bank, Citigold) serving high-net-worth clients across 20 countries. While JPM groups these international consumer assets into a holding/corporate bucket to highlight their distinct nature, C integrates its international wealth operations into its primary Wealth segment definition, illustrating different structural approaches to reporting international consumer/wealth exposure.

sentences.text: Other Corporate includes the Firm's international consumer initiatives, which primarily consists of Chase U.K., Nutmeg, and an ownership stake in C6 Bank.

Wealth includes the Private Bank, Wealth at Work and Citigold businesses and provides financial services to a range of client segments including affluent, high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients through banking, lending, mortgages, investment, custody and trust product offerings in 20 countries, including the U.S., Mexico and four wealth management centers: Singapore, Hong Kong, the UAE and London.
